name: Movin' On
org: Montana Center on Inclusive Education, MSU Billings
what_you_do: Visit MSU Billings, City College and Rocky Mountain College. Get a mentor who is a college student with a disability. There is also a four day summer camp in the dorms.
who_can_apply: High school students with a documented disability, an IEP or a 504 plan. The summer camp is limited to 30 students. The page does not list grades or ages.
pay_detail: Free. Tuition, fees, books, lodging and meals are covered for accepted camp students.
deadline_text: The page says Summer Camp 2027 information is coming soon. No dates or deadline are posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not list student steps. Schools that want to take part should contact Richie Solomon at 406-657-2092 or richard.solomon@msubillings.edu.
notes: If you do the campus visits in the school year, you get into the summer camp if you want to go.
